data.headline: Professional House Cleaning Tailored to Your Toronto Home
data.body:
At SparkleClean Pro, our house cleaning service is built around the reality of modern Toronto life. Whether you're a working professional with a packed schedule, a family juggling school runs and after-school activities, or an Airbnb host preparing a property for the next guest, our team arrives fully equipped and ready to deliver a spotless result — every single visit.

A standard SparkleClean Pro house cleaning covers every room in your home with careful, methodical attention:

- Kitchen surfaces, appliances, sinks, and cabinet fronts wiped down and sanitized
- Bathrooms scrubbed thoroughly — toilets, showers, tubs, mirrors, and floors
- All floors vacuumed and mopped, including under furniture
- Bedrooms dusted, bedding straightened, and surfaces wiped
- Living areas dusted, cushions fluffed, and high-touch points sanitized
- Baseboards, light switches, door handles, and window ledges cleaned

We use only **eco-friendly, non-toxic cleaning products** that are safe for children, pets, and allergy-sensitive households — without compromising on cleaning power. Every product in our kit meets our strict environmental standards, so your home is genuinely clean, not just surface-level fresh.

Choose from a **one-time deep clean** for a special occasion or post-renovation refresh, or set up **recurring visits** — weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly — so your home stays consistently immaculate without you lifting a finger. SparkleClean Pro is bonded and insured, giving you full peace of mind every time we enter your home.

introEyebrow.text: What We Do & Who We Serve

data.headline: Expert Window Cleaning for Toronto Homes and Commercial Spaces
data.body:
Window Cleaning is one of the most impactful ways to refresh the look and feel of any property — yet it is also one of the most frequently overlooked. At SparkleClean Pro, we provide comprehensive interior and exterior window cleaning services for residential homes, condos, office buildings, retail storefronts, and Airbnb properties throughout Toronto and the surrounding areas.

Our trained technicians remove dirt, grime, hard-water deposits, and streaks from every pane, leaving glass crystal-clear and your view unobstructed. Every visit includes cleaning of window screens and frames, so nothing is left behind. For upper-floor or hard-to-reach windows, we use safe, professional-grade equipment and techniques that eliminate the need for ladders on your part.

**Who benefits most from our Window Cleaning service?**

- **Busy families** who want bright, clean homes without the weekend hassle
- **Working professionals** who take pride in a polished living space
- **Office managers** looking to maintain a professional first impression for clients and staff
- **Airbnb hosts** who need sparkling windows between every guest turnover

All SparkleClean Pro window cleaning technicians are bonded and insured, giving you complete peace of mind every time we step onto your property. Same-day booking is available — so even last-minute clean-ups before a showing, an event, or a new guest check-in are never a problem.

image.alt: Sparkling clean windows on a Toronto residential property after a SparkleClean Pro visit

data.headline: How Our Window Cleaning Service Works
data.body: SparkleClean Pro follows a thorough, proven process on every job — so you always know exactly what to expect and can count on flawless results from start to finish.

items.title: On-Site Assessment & Prep
items.text: We begin every Window Cleaning appointment with a quick walkthrough of your property. Our technician identifies any stubborn staining, hard-water buildup, or high-access windows that need special attention, then protects surrounding surfaces before any cleaning begins.
bullets: Interior and exterior window count confirmed
High-reach areas flagged for safe equipment setup
Sills and frames inspected for damage

items.title: Eco-Friendly Solution Application
items.text: We apply our biodegradable, streak-free cleaning solution to every pane. Our eco-friendly products are tough on grease, grime, and mineral deposits but completely safe for your family, pets, and the environment — a core commitment at SparkleClean Pro.

items.title: Interior & Exterior Glass Cleaning
items.text: Every window is cleaned on both sides using professional squeegees and microfibre detailing cloths. We work methodically from top to bottom, eliminating streaks and ensuring a crystal-clear finish across all glass surfaces — including skylights where accessible.
bullets: Both interior and exterior surfaces cleaned

items.title: Screen, Frame & Sill Detail
items.text: Clean glass deserves clean surroundings. After the glass itself is done, we remove, rinse, and reinstall window screens, then wipe down frames and sills to remove accumulated dust and debris. The result is a complete, polished finish — not just clean panes.
bullets: Frames wiped down inside and out
Sills cleared of dirt and debris

items.title: Quality Check & Final Inspection
items.text: Before we consider the job complete, every technician conducts a final walk-around with the client (or on their behalf when no one is home). We verify every pane is streak-free, every screen is in place, and the workspace is left cleaner than we found it.

items.answer: Yes — every SparkleClean Pro Window Cleaning visit covers both the interior and exterior surfaces of your windows. We also clean screens, frames, and sills as part of the standard service, so you get a completely finished result rather than just clean glass on one side.

items.question: Are your cleaning products safe for children and pets?
items.answer: Absolutely. SparkleClean Pro uses only biodegradable, eco-friendly cleaning solutions that are non-toxic and safe for households with children, pets, and allergy-sensitive individuals. You do not need to vacate the property during or after the clean.

items.answer: Yes. Our technicians are trained and equipped to safely clean upper-floor and high-access windows using professional-grade extension tools and water-fed poles. Because we are bonded and insured, you have full peace of mind for any work carried out at height on your Toronto property.

Contact SparkleClean Pro by phone or through our online booking form and we will do our best to arrange a technician for you the same day — especially useful before an Airbnb guest check-in, a property showing, or a special event.
